_about: Landing intro (CODE_JOB_F5_intro.md §3, 8 Nov 2026; board Story_Intro). Captions are J.B.'s drafts, kept here so they can be edited without touching code (tool/f1intro.js reads this file). Scene 2 has no caption in the job sheet: its caption is the board's. Counts are not written here: scene 2 reads tool/data/approval_counts.json at run time. 's' = seconds the scene runs.

scenes.title: The question
captions: Data centres are infrastructure the modern world runs on.
How could better planning, siting, design and engineering make them give back more than digital services?

scenes.title: Two cities
captions: Two cities. Every lot where one could go.
scenes.count: lots where a data centre is allowed
scenes.key: zones where a data centre is allowed
scenes.source: Counts read by the tool from tool/data/approval_counts.json (permitted and conditional lots); zones from tool/data/zones.json on the City zoning maps. No lot outlines are drawn.

scenes.title: Four templates
captions: Four templates. Pick the one that matches your question.

lines.resident: Data centres near you: where, what type, how they run
lines.municipal: The rules on any lot: zoning, height, noise, approvals
lines.engineering: Size one on a lot, and what it could share: heat, power
lines.architecture: What could be built with it: programs, layout

scenes.title: The workflow
captions: Each template has a workflow: its steps are in the strip along the bottom. Click any step to jump to it.

scenes.title: The interactive logic diagrams
captions: Each template has an interactive logic diagram: the sources, sums and confidence behind every figure. Open it from How it works.

scenes.title: Where to start
captions: Start a template's workflow, or open its interactive logic diagram.
